mito2::cache

Module range_cache 

Source
Expand description

Coordinates range-result cache loads and SST retirement. No I/O or decoding runs under the coordinator lock; loaders use the shared query runtime.

Cached result for one range scan.
Entry 🔒
RangeCacheDelivery 🔒
Keeps completed results charged while subscribers or replay streams own them. Cache entries retain only a weak reference: after the last reader leaves, the resident value is covered solely by the cache’s capacity accounting.
RangeCacheScope 🔒
Separates active scans with different query memory reservations. Completed results are reusable across scopes. The default scope is for sources without a query-specific memory pool.
RangeLoad 🔒
Readers own the scan; the coordinator only retains a weak registration. Query-pool identity isolates active reservations, not completed cache values.
RangeRegistration 🔒
RangeResultCache 🔒
Stores completed range results and coordinates reader-owned shared scans.
